title: P15.10-B R2: close residual F4 hole — faultCode/sanitizeFaultReason exact allowlists; production stays RECONCILE_ONLY
description: R2 independent-audit remediation on PR #86 (audited HEAD 160907e0cd7eb12a53ff896a3d05cb313ea3e2a3, BASE 88cdf85b99080b5b2da9dda13c9fae5154108c70). Residual F4 finding reproduced with 3 adversarial tests before patching (3/3 failed prepatch): error.code values like FAIL_CLOSED_AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE and uppercase reasons like SECRET_XYZ_CANARY passed the shape regex and persisted verbatim. faultCode now admits only an exact allowlist of internal codes (the five FAIL_CLOSED_* codes this module produces/classifies on) and otherwise returns a fixed classification label (SQLITE_CONTENTION/NOT_FOUND/INTEGRITY_FAULT/UNEXPECTED_FAULT); regex/prefix/namespace checks are no longer used as trust proof. sanitizeFaultReason admits only allowlisted codes or classification labels, else UNSPECIFIED_FAULT. Retry classification (retryableFault reads the original error.code directly), F1 durable cursor/replay, F2 canonical WakeBinding, F3 idle-write elimination, lease/CAS/fairness and production RECONCILE_ONLY are unchanged. No merge/deploy.
